_about: Per-platform limits read by scripts/postcheck.py. Every value was written from memory on the date shown and is unverified: platforms change these without notice, so open the source named and correct the value before posting. An entry with "kind": "guidance" produces a warning; every other entry is treated as a hard limit and produces a failure. Counting methods: 'codepoints' counts Unicode code points; 'weighted' counts code points inside light_ranges as 1 and all others as 2; 'graphemes' counts what a reader sees as one character (approximated: combining marks, joiners, variation selectors and skin-tone modifiers do not count, a flag pair counts once). Where url_chars is set, every link counts as that many characters whatever its real length.
